title: Morepen Laboratories launches Desloratadine (Rx) generic drug product in US market
summary: Morepen Laboratories has launched its prescription generic product Desloratadine in the United States market. This launch is managed through the company's subsidiary, Morpen Bio. Inc. The product will be available in 100-count and 500-count packs to...

contentHtml:
Pharmaceutical company Morepen Laboratories announced on Monday the launch of its prescription (Rx) generic product Desloratadine for distrubtion in the US market. The initiative is being undertaken through its wholly owned local subsidiary, Morpen Bio. Inc., according to the company’s statement.

According to the release, the generic product is set to launch in 100-count and 500-count packs.

Desloratadine has been supplied to the US market for many years by the firm; the latest launch builds on their established API position, extending the company’s participation further along the pharmaceutical value chain into finished-dosage medicines and US distribution, said the release.

Morepen’s prescription generics expansion follows its earlier US over-the-counter (OTC) product introductions.

Separately, the company has also submitted its first Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) to the US FDA for Sitagliptin Phosphate Tablets USP, 25 mg, 50 mg and 100 mg. The application is currently under regulatory review, said the release.
